study type: Outbreak investigation based on prospective surveillance
exposure: Multi-drug resistant gram negative bacilli (MDR GNB)
colonization with rectal Multi-drug resistant gram negative bacilli (MDR GNB)
maternal Lower segment cesarean section (LSCS) wound
cohort: All neonates admitted to a 30-bed tertiary care NICU in 2018
finding: Surveillance aids in the early detection and successful control of outbreaks in the NICU setting.
